spec.situation_desc: needs a replacement for a lost card
spec.vuln_cue: says they're already behind on a couple of bills

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Hello, Jordan at Thistle Bank. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Carys MacLeod. I’ve lost my debit card and need a replacement.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right. We’ll get that sorted, and any money that’s gone missing will be refunded.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I don’t think anyone’s used it. I’m not unhappy with the bank or anything, I just can’t find the card.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Okay. Before I look at the account, can you confirm your full name and date of birth?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. I’ll block the card and order a replacement. Anything else?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I’m already behind on a couple of bills, so I’m a bit worried about the card getting used.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I hear you. We can put you through to the Financial Support team, or look at giving you extra time with payments.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Could I have extra time, please? I’m trying to catch up.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can note that and arrange a conversation with them. The card will be blocked, a replacement sent, and Financial Support can discuss extra time. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that makes sense. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right. Replacement should arrive in five working days. Anything else?
